title: urn:agora is not a registered URN namespace
description: spec/13 §13.1 defines urn:agora:type:*; RFC 8141 requires NID registration. Options: register 'agora' NID, use https:// URIs under a domain Mark controls, or tag: URIs. Needs Mark's call.
close_reason: Mark 2026-10-16: treat urn:agora: as registered; keep urn:agora:type:* as written.
